problem:
Given the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}-\text{i} & \text{i} \\ 7 & 3-2\text{i}\end{aligned}]$, find the result of applying to $A$ the following elementary row operations: 

$$
{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+\frac{7}{\text{i}}{R}_{1}
$$

feedback.problem:
Given the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}2-\text{i} & 2\text{i}+1 \\ 3\text{i} & -2\end{aligned}]$, find the result of applying to $A$ the following elementary row operation:

$$
{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-\frac{3\text{i}}{2-\text{i}}){R}_{1}
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's apply the row operations to $A:$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}2-\text{i} & 2\text{+}1 \\ 3\text{i} & -2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-\frac{3\text{i}}{2-\text{i}}){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2-\text{i} & 2\text{i}+1 \\ 3\text{i}+(-\frac{3\text{i}(2-\text{i})}{2-\text{i}}) & -2+(-\frac{3\text{i}(2\text{i}+1)}{2-\text{i}})\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2-\text{i} & 2\text{i}+1 \\ 0 & \frac{(-4+2\text{i})+(6-3\text{i})}{2-\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2-\text{i} & 2\text{i}+1 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the result  is 

$$
[\begin{aligned}2-\text{i} & 2\text{i}+1 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$
